intro: An app for guys who want to understand their partner’s cycle, and be there at the right moment.

features.dial_body: Night, Dawn, Day, Dusk: where she is today, what it changes for her, and how to be there.
features.notebook_body: Jot things down when you notice something. Next cycle, the app reminds you what helped.
features.agenda_body: The key periods in your calendar, and a widget on your home screen.

ios.title: iPhone
ios.steps_link:
1. Install the TestFlight app from the App Store.
2. Open the invitation link below, then install HerDays.

android.title: Android
android.steps:
1. Open the downloaded file.
2. If Android blocks it, allow installs from this source.
3. If Play Protect warns you: “Install anyway”.
On Samsung, turn off “Auto Blocker” while installing.
